decisions.decision: Flipped SAFE_TEXT_RE allowlist to UNSAFE_TEXT_RE blocklist (blocks < > ` { } only)
decisions.rationale: Allowlist breaks every time upstream brands use new punctuation (Kopp's pipe char caused 502)

decisions.decision: Easter Sunday 'No data' is not a bug -- Culver's is closed
decisions.rationale: API correctly returns no data for Easter; added holiday detection instead

decisions.decision: Used Azure OpenAI gpt-image-1.5 for buster cone art with L5 pixel art prompt
decisions.rationale: Matches existing cone art pipeline; user accepted result despite wrong line orientation

decisions.decision: visualViewport API for keyboard-aware bottom sheet
decisions.rationale: CSS vh/dvh don't respond to iOS virtual keyboard; visualViewport.height is the only reliable signal

next_action: Test on real iPhone. If still broken, inspect iOS Safari DevTools for what's different from Playwright. Focus on header layout and store picker keyboard behavior.

User noted buster cone line orientation is wrong but accepted it. The header/store picker may still have issues on real iOS -- Playwright can't fully replicate iOS Safari keyboard behavior.
